description: This file defines internal interfaces and classes related to cluster manifest management within the Orleans runtime. It includes an interface for retrieving cluster manifests and updates, as well as a class representing a cluster manifest update with associated metadata.

classes.name: ClusterManifestUpdate
classes.description: Represents an update to the cluster manifest, including version info, silo manifests, and a flag indicating if all active servers are included.

methods.name: GetClusterManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the current cluster manifest asynchronously.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Fetches an updated cluster manifest if it's newer than the specified previous version.
